caption: The drawing features a single large, cylindrical stoneware jar with a slightly narrowed neck and wide, rounded rim. The jar has two small lug handles on opposite sides near the top, each showing blue decorative accents. The overall surface of the jar is glazing in a light brownish-gray color, with darker brown and tan spots and streaks distributed irregularly. There appears to be an inscription or stamp on the upper portion of the jar, partly legible, possibly indicating a maker or location. The jar is positioned upright on a plain, light beige background with no additional objects or scenery. At the bottom right of the drawing, "S. Jerome Hoxie" and the number "36" are handwritten in small letters.
title: Butter Crock
